name: LOKAL BLOK

coord_source.ref: node/2309326372 (OSM name: Lokal Blok, náměstí 14. října 10, climbing:boulder=yes, website lokalblok.cz)

research_notes: Climbing-wall page: hours Mo/We/Fr 12-22:30, Tu/Th 7-22:30, Sa-Su 14-22, monthly 'Bouldering session' with the October session on 2026-10-06, courses and children's boulder competitions; the restaurant of the same name is in the same building. The wall is a bouldering wall (events, session wording); the page does not give its size.

name: Jungle Letňany

coord_source.ref: node/9377475599 (OSM name: Jungle, Veselská 699, website jungleletnany.cz, sport climbing;parkour;gymnastics)

research_notes: Branch site: 'otevřeno každý den', Veselská 699, 'one of the largest climbing walls in Prague and a two-storey boulder wall' ('dvoupatrová boulderovka'). Chain list at jungle.cz names Letňany, Holešovice, Pardubice (already in Bouldeer as Jungle Pardubice), Mladá Boleslav, Výstaviště (outdoor) and a not yet open Ostrava branch.

name: Jungle Holešovice

research_notes: Branch site (formerly Boulder Bar / boulder.cz): U Výstaviště 11, weekday hours 9-14:30 and 17:45-22, weekend 9-22, closure notice for 2026-10-10 (competition), Boulder Boj series 2026. The older Bouldeer entry 'Boulder Bar' (50.1058, 14.4346) is probably the same gym under its former name; reconcile will show the pair.

name: Flash Boulder Bar

coord_source.ref: node/296657887 (OSM address point Rokytova 4259/1, Brno; Photon house-number geocode; the OSM gym node 767305977 at Jaroslava Foglara is the closed 2010-2022 site)

research_notes: Own site contact page: operating site Obchodní centrum Lerk, Rokytova 1, Brno - Židenice (first floor above OKEY), hours Mo-Fr 6-21, Sa-Su 8-20, entry CZK 150; spray wall, Moonboard and a boulder gym. News: the old Brno wall closed in September 2022 and 'Flash Boulder je znovu v Brně' reopened in November 2022 at the new address. The OSM node of the gym is still at the old Jaroslava Foglara site; do not use it.
